settings.title: Formula
settings.description: The value is calculated automatically from the record's other fields and cannot be edited by hand.
settings.resultTypeHint: Defines how the value is stored, shown and filtered.
settings.decimalsHint: From 0 to 6. Empty keeps the calculated value.
settings.currencyResultHint: This formula uses currency fields, but the result is a Number and will show without the currency symbol. Choose the Currency result type to display the value with its currency.

editor.label: Expression
editor.hint: Use field keys, operators (+ - * /, = != < <= > >=, and, or, not) and functions. Click the items beside to insert them.
editor.checkFailed: The expression could not be validated right now.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.today: Uses today's date: the value is recalculated every day.
dependencies.none: The expression does not use other fields.

catalog.title: Insert into the expression
catalog.loadError: The fields and functions could not be loaded.
catalog.relationFields: Sum or average a field of {{relation}}
catalog.noRelations: This record type has no relations that can be aggregated.

functions.days_between: Days between two dates (end minus start).
functions.add_days: Adds (or subtracts) days to a date.
functions.if: Returns the second value when the condition is true, otherwise the third.
functions.coalesce: First value that is not empty.
functions.is_empty: True when the value is empty.
functions.concat: Joins texts and values into a single text.
functions.len: Number of characters of the text.
functions.round: Rounds the number to the given decimal places.
functions.min: Smallest of the values, or the smallest value of a related field.
functions.max: Largest of the values, or the largest value of a related field.
functions.sum: Sum of a field of the related records.
functions.avg: Average of a field of the related records.

preview.title: Preview
preview.recordHint: Choose a record to see the value the formula calculates for it.
preview.notEvaluated: Fix the expression to calculate the value.
preview.recordNotFound: The chosen record was not found or you have no access to it.

errors.unexpected_end: The expression ends earlier than expected.
errors.expression_too_long: The expression is too long (2000 characters at most).
errors.expression_too_complex: The expression is too complex. Simplify it.
errors.unsupported_field: This field cannot be used in formulas.
errors.wrong_arguments: Wrong number or type of arguments for the function.
errors.type_mismatch: The value types do not match in this operation.
errors.related_outside_aggregate: Related record fields can only be used inside count, sum, avg, min or max.
errors.incompatible_result: The expression result does not match the chosen result type.
errors.formula_cycle: The formula creates a circular dependency between fields.
errors.field_not_accessible: You have no access to this field.
